## Requirements: App Environment / Experience Layout / Surface Geometry / Terminal Runtime unified layout & keyboard avoidance

### Background and verified baseline (main, 2026-11-14)
User-reported behavior: on phone, focusing the Capsule appears to lift its input above the soft keyboard, but focusing Terminal does not reliably lift the work surface; vertical movement while keyboard is visible feels unsmooth. This is a **reported symptom**, not an independently reproduced Safari/Android runtime root cause.

Source-level architecture review:
- `web/src/index.css`: `html,body,#root { height:100dvh; overflow:hidden; overscroll-behavior:none }`.
- `web/src/app/Shell.tsx`: Shell is `h-[100dvh]`; it does not publish a unified visual-viewport/keyboard-occlusion contract.
- `web/src/app/experiences/app/AppLayout.tsx` and `AppLayers.tsx`: Terminal is the continuously mounted root; Sessions/Workspace are absolute translating slabs; layer root uses `overflow-hidden`. Preserve this product/navigation invariant.
- `web/src/app/ShellMain.tsx`: App Session Header takes normal flex height; TerminalWell fills remaining content height.
- `web/src/app/TerminalWell.tsx`, `web/src/product/terminal/patterns/TerminalSurface.tsx`: overflow-clipped well, floating Capsule and nested terminal viewport; there is no Experience-owned keyboard avoidance scrollport.
- `web/src/product/terminal/capsule/hooks/useCapsuleDockClearance.ts`: correctly separates **composer occlusion** (real terminal fit) from **upper-panel clearance** (normal-shell reversible scroll). Listening to `visualViewport.resize` here only remeasures the dock; it does not itself define global keyboard avoidance.
- `web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/view/TerminalGeometry.ts`: ResizeObserver/content-height/clearance produce local rows and lease-gated remote reporting. Preserve canonical fixed columns and existing TUI `viewport-reserve` exception (#3492).
- `web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/input/MobileImeInput.ts`: real almost-transparent textarea follows xterm's cursor cell; it is not a page scroll/layout owner and can be an unreliable browser automatic-focus avoidance target.
- `web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/capsule/occlusionScroll.ts`: touch drags are claimed and routed to xterm local history or TUI wheel depending on terminal mode (#2659); do not silently add a competing outer vertical scroller for every gesture.

### Owner decision / goal
**A soft keyboard changes the visible region (occlusion), not the Terminal's intrinsic layout size.** App-owned viewport/scroll avoidance should lift/scroll the currently focused interaction into the visible region with natural manual scrolling, **without shrinking Shell/TerminalWell, refitting xterm rows, or issuing PTY/tmux resize** on keyboard animation.

By contrast, a real layout-space change (normal App header, actual composer height, orientation/window/container resize) may legitimately affect Terminal usable height and rows. Existing mode-aware expanded-panel policy (#2710/#3492) remains authoritative; do not conflate keyboard with panel reserve.

Canonical ownership is the three-tier layout doctrine from #3194 (`docs/design/composition.md`): Experience host owns frame, safe areas and scroll ancestry; reusable semantic layout recipes own shared relationships; capability-local content stays local. This Requirement adds **environment/occlusion semantics** under that Experience host, not a new global layout DSL or a parallel source of truth.

### Four-level layout contract

| Owner | Inputs and writes | Must NOT do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **App Environment** (new shared App experience adapter) | Read `window.visualViewport` available geometry (`offsetTop/Left, width, height, scale`), window/layout viewport, safe-area measurements and lifecycle; publish consistent **layout bounds**, **visual bounds** and **occluded edges** in a single coordinate system; tolerate absent API and non-keyboard viewport changes | Mutate terminal geometry; infer keyboard solely from `innerHeight - visualViewport.height`; create an additional global CSS `100dvh` writer |
| **Experience Layout** (`Shell`, `AppLayers`, active layer) | Own page frame, active-layer focus target, safe area, scroll ancestry, avoidance scroll offset/range, settle/restore; ensure no hidden layer scrolls the visible one | Ask xterm/PTY to resize due to keyboard; make `body` globally scrollable; take ownership of all vertical gestures or rebuild the Terminal on navigation |
| **Surface Layout** (`TerminalWell/TerminalSurface/Capsule`) | Measure real header/composer occupied height and local overlay clearance; publish existing separate composer and upper-panel clearances; route focus coordinates without declaring keyboard semantics | Count the keyboard as composer/panel height; independently translate Shell or claim its global scroll range |
| **Terminal Runtime** (`TerminalViewport/Geometry/IME/Scroll`) | Use **actual** content box/scroll mode for xterm geometry; retain cursor-anchored IME for candidate placement; mode-aware normal-buffer/alternate-screen/mouse scroll and upper-panel policy; ControlLease-gated rows updates | Resize on purely visual-viewport movement or focus/avoidance-scroll offset; apply two independent transforms/scroll owners to same gesture |

**Separate three dimensions**: 
1. `layoutBounds`: stable CSS layout geometry that component flex/grid consumes.
2. `visibleBounds`: browser-visible rectangle, translated into App Shell coordinates; can change from keyboard, browser toolbar, pan/zoom, scroll and orientation.
3. `surfaceOcclusion`: measured floating internal UI overlap (composer vs upper panel) with an explicit policy; not interchangeable with `visibleBounds`.

No `keyboardHeight` global source of truth based only on a visual-viewport delta. Infer an actionable keyboard avoidance session from focus on an editable input **plus** reduced visibility; read the real visible rect for avoidance. Browser zoom/pan, toolbar changes, and missing `visualViewport` must not be misclassified into a terminal resize or unbounded scroll.

### Proposed component / API design (semantic, not forced file naming)

```text
App Shell (layout height stays stable)
├─ AppViewportEnvironment (single read/coordinate owner)
│  └─ snapshot { layoutBounds, visibleBounds, safeArea, occludedEdges, revision }
└─ AppLayers (one active navigation layer, Terminal remains mounted)
   ├─ Terminal layer
   │  ├─ Session Header (real flow size)
   │  └─ Experience-owned KeyboardAvoidanceScrollport
   │     ├─ TerminalWell (same measured layout height)
   │     │  ├─ TerminalViewport / xterm
   │     │  └─ Capsule dock (existing two clearances)
   │     └─ ephemeral avoidance scroll extent (NOT TerminalWell height)
   ├─ Sessions layer (own local scroll, no Terminal geometry mutation)
   └─ Workspace layer (existing Workspace scroll recipe, active-focus avoidance)
```

**Snapshot contract**: `layoutBounds` and `visibleBounds` must use one explicitly documented coordinate space (recommended Shell-local CSS px converted from `visualViewport` plus window scroll where necessary); no consumer mixes viewport-, page- and element-local rects. Environment updates coalesce within animation frames and do not force React re-render or geometry remeasure for unchanged meaningful values. `visualViewport.resize` **and** `visualViewport.scroll` are inputs; `window.resize`, orientation and focus changes are fallbacks/triggers; clean up on teardown. Compare effective numeric bounds before publishing. Never write `Shell.style.height = visualViewport.height`.

**Active scroll owner contract**: keyboard avoidance is the duty of the active Experience layer. In the Terminal layer the scrollport exposes an explicit temporary bottom scroll extent **outside TerminalWell's height and outside the xterm ResizeObserver-measured element**. Focusing the Capsule textarea or Terminal mobile IME records an element/caret target and scrolls only enough for that target + touch-safe margin to lie within `visibleBounds`, with browser-native scrollability after the movement. Re-check after visual viewport settles/caret movements; clamp to legal scroll range. Do not rely solely on `element.scrollIntoView` or a `transform: translateY` on the xterm screen to fake scroll range. On blur/keyboard close, remove temporary extent and restore/clamp scroll position (without jumping during a normal user scroll); preserve terminal mount, output and history anchor.

**Touch/gesture boundary**: horizontal App edge/pager gestures remain AppLayers-owned; outside avoidable visible overflow, terminal vertical drags remain xterm scrollback/TUI wheel-owned, and selection/direction-pad/multitouch stay unchanged. When a keyboard is actually occluding the active layer and an avoidance scroll range exists, offer an explicit bounded vertical scroll path to move the **outer page**, without dispatching the same delta to `occlusionScroll`. Decide ownership at gesture start/axis lock; hand over only at defined ends, never both at once. Preserve browser's touch scrolling and momentum on the outer scrollport; terminal's custom touch path remains its existing mode-aware mechanism. The scrollport must not intercept keyboard-dismiss taps as scroll or steal TUI mouse-tracking input when not moving the page.

**Resize policy**:
- Normal app/environment changes (orientation, real container size/header/content size) => TerminalGeometry may remeasure rows; cols stay fixed.
- Keyboard/visualViewport changes, focus, avoidance scroll offset => unchanged TerminalWell/contentRect, xterm grid rows, PTY rows and remote resize request count.
- Composer actual multiline height => existing measured composer occlusion changes fit; only changed whole-row result sends deduped debounced authorized resize.
- Upper panel normal-buffer/no-mouse => `scroll-clearance` preserving rows + reversible two-way local pan (#2710).
- Upper panel alternate screen or mouse tracking => `viewport-reserve` and authorized rows only; observer/too-small surface compact fallback (#3492). A simultaneous keyboard must **not** add another reserve or second resize.

**Non-goals**: changing root `100dvh` based on keyboard; global `body` scrolling; adding a second PTY sizing path; rewriting #2710/#3492 panel policy; altering tmux column count; inventing generic universal layout components; replacing xterm IME with a normal large textarea.

### Scenario matrix / test contract

| Context | Expected visual/scroll behavior | May change xterm/PTY rows? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Capsule focus opens IME | Focused composer visible above visual bottom; shell/work layout intact; native outer scroll available | **No** |
| Tap Terminal + cursor-tethered IME | Terminal input/candidate remains functional; active scroll owner can reveal cursor/interaction, no clipped dead-end | **No** |
| Hide IME, change keyboard candidate/toolbar height | Extent and scroll reconcile; no page/terminal remount, no resize storm | **No** |
| Browser toolbar, visual viewport scroll/zoom without editable focus | Stable layout, no false keyboard reserve/scroll jump | **No** (unless true layout changes) |
| Composer 1→multi→1 lines | Existing composer-only measured fit changes; resize only if integer rows change | **Yes, if rows change** |
| Open/close Context/Keys Peek in normal shell | Reversible local scroll clearance, original top/history and live bottom both reachable | **No** |
| Open/close Peek in full-screen/mouse TUI | Existing bounded real row reserve, valid bottom interaction row; short/no ControlLease => compact fallback | **Only current Controller, by existing policy** |
| Keyboard + Peek in normal shell / TUI | No double-spend of keyboard and panel pixels; focus handling and remaining space safe | **Panel policy only** |
| Sessions/Workspace navigation while keyboard visible | One active scroll owner, independent layer states, focused input not leaked into hidden layer; terminal instance preserved | **No** |
| Portrait/landscape + nonzero safe area | Correct coordinate mapping, reachable focus/controls, no clipped or inaccessible region | **Only true layout/orientation change** |

### Implementation phases / dependency order
1. **Contract + instrumentation (P0)**: extend `docs/design/composition.md` and `docs/design/interaction/app.md`; cross-reference terminal-surface/capsule/terminal-sizing docs without duplicating their rules; introduce one deterministic, mockable App Environment adapter and observable `data-*`/test probes. Distinguish `layoutBounds`, `visibleBounds`, and `surfaceOcclusion`.
2. **Experience-owned scrollport (P1; depends P0)**: in `app/experiences/app`, add/compose active-layer scroll ancestor + ephemeral extent; constrain to active layer; preserve header/layer topology, PopupPortal clipping/stacking, safe-area and session mount.
3. **Focus + gesture integration (P2; depends P1)**: Capsule normal textarea and MobileImeInput publish focus targets; terminal caret scroll targeting is separate from terminal buffer scroll, prevents duplicate touch ownership; keyboard dismiss/restore, re-entry and pan/zoom.
4. **Geometry firewall (P3; parallel with P2, depends P0)**: assert visual-only updates cannot feed TerminalGeometry rows; preserve and cover composer and TUI reserve exceptions, ControlLease/observer generation boundaries.
5. **Cross-state browser regression + prototype (P4)**: source-aligned Chromium/Playwright at 375×812, 390×844, 430×932, 844×390 with deterministic visibleBounds+safe-area input, keyboard focus, touch, true composer height, TUI modes, observer and navigation; review same Scope in required interactive prototype before signoff.

### Prototype
- **Decision:** Required — new cross-layer keyboard avoidance/scroll interaction and two potential gesture owners require an interactive scenario review.
- **Open interaction uncertainty:** Should the App Header remain visible while the active work surface scrolls to keyboard, and how should a vertical gesture on xterm choose outer avoidance vs inner terminal history when both have available range? Product choice to be made inside the prototype; do not let implementation implicitly choose.
- **Scenario:** App 390×844 portrait + 844×390 landscape; toggle keyboard/capsule focus/terminal focus, composer single/multi-line, upper Peek shell/TUI, observer, and layer navigation; show frame/visible geometry, outer scroll position, terminal rows and PTY resize counter.
- **Status:** Planned; **no prototype created or published yet**. This is an explicit implementation dependency before final UX signoff.
- **Artifact/fidelity:** Pending exact orphan `prototype` source SHA + verified Pages HTML/manifest; mock cannot prove production xterm/IME/native Safari behavior.
- **Existing linked artifacts:** #2710/#3492 Terminal Keys prototype and #3194 layout prototype remain valid for their current scoped behaviors; inspect and revise in place only if new behavior invalidates their demonstrated state.

### SC → primary verification scenario and approved proof lane
- **SC-01, SC-02, SC-03, SC-04, SC-05, SC-06 → SCN-02** (Chromium/App interactive browser): approved source-aligned `browser` Acceptance Case on isolated CI, Playwright controlled `visualViewport`/safe-area fixture, DOM rect/scrollTop, xterm geometry, focus and no-double-event assertions; earliest trustworthy boundary is merged **staging** source SHA. This proves Nession-owned behavior, not physical iOS Safari keyboard animation.
- **SC-07 → SCN-03** (terminal/runtime): approved isolated Server+Agent+tmux `runtime` / `terminal-io` Case on staging SHA, count resize requests, `stty size`, ControlLease/observer path and real composer/panel exceptions. No privileged external credentials.
- **SC-08 → SCN-01** (deterministic contract): source-aligned canonical docs/design and named owner rules plus design Gate/negative fixture at exact PR head; agent reads independently executed relevant Gate receipt and code.
- No new/unknown proof mode, no human-device-only SC, no main-only or deployed SC.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 App experience publishes consistent, observable layout-vs-visible geometry across controlled `visualViewport.resize/scroll`, window resize, orientation and nonzero safe-area fixtures; simulated toolbar/zoom or missing API does not falsely change Shell/Terminal layout or invent a keyboard-only scroll state.
- [ ] SC-02 With keyboard-like visible bounds and focus on either Capsule textarea or terminal mobile IME, user can reveal the active caret/control above the visible bottom using bounded, reversible **real outer scrolling**; TerminalWell dimensions, xterm grid rows and Terminal instance identity remain unchanged across keyboard open/adjust/close.
- [ ] SC-03 While keyboard avoidance range exists, vertical touch/manual scroll moves only the designated outer scroll owner; horizontal edge navigation, xterm history/TUI wheel, terminal selection, long-press directional pad and multitouch remain available in their respective owned gestures, with no doubled scroll/cancelled valid taps.
- [ ] SC-04 Changing Capsule composer from one to multiline and back updates composer-only clearance and eventual rows exactly as dictated by the existing fit; keyboard-only movement and normal upper-panel appearance do **not** change that composer fit input; no oscillatory row changes from repeated equivalent environment snapshots.
- [ ] SC-05 Expanded Capsule panel preserves #2710 normal-buffer reversible scroll clearance and #3492 alternate-screen/mouse/TUI authorized reserve + observer/short-height compact fallback; concurrent keyboard avoidance never double-counts panel height or changes terminal mode routing.
- [ ] SC-06 Active-layer keyboard avoidance works at canonical portrait/landscape and nonzero safe-area fixtures; switching Sessions/Terminal/Workspace and opening a relevant dialog preserves independent scroll/focus ownership, exactly one App header, same mounted Terminal and no stranded controls outside the visible region.
- [ ] SC-07 In isolated real terminal runtime, keyboard-only viewport/focus/avoidance sequence sends **zero** `agent.terminal.resize` and leaves authoritative tmux rows/cols unchanged; actual composer or eligible TUI panel row changes retain deduped Controller-only requests and observer/stale-generation rejection.
- [x] SC-08 Canonical App composition + interaction docs and owning design/terminal contract specify the four ownership levels and the scenario matrix; an exact-SHA deterministic check/fixture prevents a regression where capability-local code owns global keyboard scroll or injects visual-viewport height directly into TerminalGeometry while allowing legitimate component-local flex/grid.

## Product alignment
- [x] **VISION.md:** continuous Session across devices, keyboard does not disrupt active work.
- [x] **PRINCIPLE.md:** current work is dominant; no added permanent chrome; Experience owns coherent behavior.
- [x] **docs/design/composition.md**, **interaction/app.md**, **terminal-surface.md**, **terminal-capsule.md**, **terminal-sizing.md**, **web/AGENTS.md**, #3194 layout ownership checked.
- [x] Explicit non-regression against existing Terminal/resize/gesture authority; not a speculative platform redesign.

### Related / dedupe
- #1047 is historical incomplete keyboard/safe-area/landscape coverage for the **Capsule-only** #1034 implementation; this Requirement adds a distinct **whole-App environment + active-layer scroll ancestry contract** and deterministic source-aligned proof. Do not count #1047's closed status as real IME proof.
- #2710 / #3492 continue to own mode-aware Capsule upper-panel scrolling/reservation, **not** outer keyboard scroll semantics; no rewriting their accepted contracts.
- #2659 continues to own terminal-internal touch/history/TUI wheel routing; this Requirement defines new outer-scroll arbitration only when keyboard-occluded.
- #3194 already owns reusable layout recipe/Gate; extend its Experience ownership, do not create competing universal layout primitives.
- #2724 owns App horizontal swipe/layer continuity, preserved without modification.

---
**Status:** In Discussion — implementation-ready ownership and proof contract; required interactive keyboard/gesture prototype pending before UX signoff.
